newsitem.title: USA: Ralston Purina SAIL notes offered.
newsitem.headline: Ralston Purina SAIL notes offered.

text.p: Ralston Purina Co said Wednesday it is offering about $420 million of seven percent exchangeable notes due August 1, 2000, stock appreciation income linked securities (SAILS) at $61.9375 per SAIL.
The SAILS are exchangeable by Ralston at maturity for shares of Interstate Bakeries Corp common stock or, at Ralston's option, for cash of equivalent value.
The shares of Interstate common stock were acquired by Ralston in connection with its sale of its Continental Baking Co subsidiary to Interstate in July 1995.
The SAILS are not subject to redemption or any sinking fund prior to maturity.
The company granted underwriters an option to purchase up to an additional $59,955,500 principal amount of SAILS to cover over-allotments if any.
Credit Suisse First Boston, Bear, Stearns & Co Inc, Lehman Brothers, J.P. Morgan & Co and Salomon Brothers Inc are the managers of the underwriting syndicate offering the SAILS.
In addition, Interstate has agreed to repurchase 1,000,000 shares of its common stock from Ralston.
Ralston said it intends to use the net proceeds from the offering of SAILS to repay short-term debt.
